# Ymnt For Development Foundation

> Independent youth-led Yemeni NGO based in Taiz, working for climate justice, environmental rights and peacebuilding through community-led action.

Ymnt For Development Foundation (مؤسسة يمنت للتنمية) is a registered Yemeni civil-society organisation (Reg. No. 60/M/2025) founded in 2021. It empowers youth, women, vulnerable and marginalised groups, and persons with disabilities through conflict-sensitive programs across climate, governance and social justice.
